'''2007 Worlds Team Steven Lewis DS Court Of The Vile Jabba''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steven Lewis]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steven Lewis]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Jabba}}
* '''Stage:''' Team
